units.source_text: 男人又对着瓶口喝了口烧酒，打起精神，跳了出去。

en.t: The man took another swig of shochu from the mouth of the bottle, braced himself, and leapt out.

units.source_text: 忽然，两眼受到了白热的铅的一击，他一个踉跄，差点没摔倒。

en.t: Suddenly, as if his eyes had been struck by white-hot lead, he staggered and nearly fell.

units.source_text: 沿着他的脚印，翻卷起的沙子，搅起了旋涡。

en.t: Along his footprints, the sand that had been churned up stirred into little whirlpools.

units.source_text: 昨晚他袭击女人，把她捆起来，就在那边吧……

en.t: It must have been over there last night that he attacked the woman and tied her up...

units.source_text: 铁锹一定就埋在那附近。

en.t: The shovel had to be buried somewhere near there.

units.source_text: 沙崩正好停了一下，可是，海一侧的崖坝，还不断有沙子流动下来。

en.t: The sand slide had just paused for a moment, but on the sea-facing side of the bank, sand was still continually streaming down.

units.source_text: 偶尔，大概是风的缘故吧，沙子离开壁面，像布片似的在空中飞舞。

en.t: Now and then, probably because of the wind, sand lifted away from the wall and fluttered through the air like scraps of cloth.

units.source_text: 他一边警惕着沙崩，一边用脚尖在沙里边摸索着。

en.t: Keeping watch for another collapse, he felt around in the sand with the tip of his foot.
